scenes.title: The Open Call
scenes.locationSubhead: Oakridge Community Hall, Brooklyn - 42 Folding Chairs

beats.speaker: max_sterling
beats.text: Every broadcast network on Earth pooled ten million dollars to crown The World's Smartest - and we start right here out of the Brooklyn rain, in front of forty-two squeaky folding chairs.

beats.speaker: producer_sam
beats.text: Grab a wet poncho and sign the clipboard, kid. Our studio symphony doesn't show up until downtown, so tonight's soundtrack is one radiator and a buzzing neon sign.

beats.speaker: frankie_russo
beats.text: Six years undefeated behind this bar, kid. Put your $250 pride on the wood or head home before the pretzels go stale.

beats.speaker: max_sterling
beats.text: Easy, Frankie. First rule of my stage: the brass clock gives you a free two-second untimed Read-In before a single tick drains. Stuck? Spend your heavy brass 50/50 or Clue coins on the ledge.

beats.speaker: max_sterling
beats.text: Feeling brave? Flip that steel 2x Double Down throw-switch before you lock in - double points if you nail it, half-tile bite if you miss. Expect braided cable switchboards and spinning analog brass dials too.

beats.speaker: max_sterling
beats.text: Grab Crown tiles across all six colors to light your 6-Wedge Jewel Medallion, and sweep any full row or column for a +300 Stage Jackpot. Step up to the mic - Frankie's waiting.

choices.label: Keep the tab open - this won't take long.
choices.playerSpokenText: Keep the tab open, Frankie. I'm taking that oak crown before the rain lets up.
choices.rivalReplyText: Ooh, we got a live wire! Somebody tell the kitchen to hold the wings, this kid wants smoke.
choices.hostReplyText: Now THAT is television! Even the forty-two folding chairs just leaned forward.

choices.label: May the sharpest memory win, Frankie.
choices.playerSpokenText: Six years undefeated deserves respect, Frankie. Let's give Oakridge a show worth remembering.
choices.rivalReplyText: Alright, class act! Win or lose, first ginger ale's on the house - just don't expect me to go easy.
choices.hostReplyText: Heartwarming sportsmanship in Brooklyn! Somebody check the thermostat, I think hell froze over.

choices.label: Do I still get free pretzels if I sweep?
choices.playerSpokenText: Quick legal question before I light up your board: do free pretzels come with a full-column sweep?
choices.rivalReplyText: Ha! Sweep a whole column on me and I'll throw in the whole jar of pickled eggs, smart-mouth.
choices.hostReplyText: Quick tongue, sharper nerves. Let's open the oak stage and see what you've got!

closingBeats.speaker: max_sterling
closingBeats.text: Spotlight on! Clear this rainy-night tryout board and your Contestant Pass gets its very first stamp.

beats.speaker: producer_sam
beats.text: Not bad for a rainstorm walk-in! Here is your cognac-leather Tour Trunk - gold yarn tracks the Main Stage, crimson yarn marks Late-Night Redemption, and plum silk leads to Secret Velvet Salons.

beats.speaker: producer_sam
beats.text: See those three recessed brass cups below the corkboard? Every rival ally or midnight salon can earn you a Podium Lucky Charm. Equip up to three before you step under the lights.

beats.speaker: max_sterling
beats.text: One more thing: three competing backers are already peeking through the curtain - Hometown Grassroots, Apex Network cash, and the mysterious Velvet Society. Who catches your eye first?

choices.label: Apex Network - put me where the big checks live.
choices.playerSpokenText: Tell Apex Network I'm camera-ready. Bring on the Showman Dares and the fattest purses.
choices.rivalReplyText: Bold call. Apex pays huge when you hit their on-air stunts - just don't blink when the red light turns on.
choices.hostReplyText: Ambition smells like freshly ironed tuxedo lapels. Love it.

choices.label: Oakridge Independent - keep my soul untagged.
choices.playerSpokenText: I walked in off a Brooklyn sidewalk. Let's stay Independent and earn every dollar the honest way.
choices.rivalReplyText: Tighter travel budget, zero corporate strings, and crowds will walk through walls for you. Respect.
choices.hostReplyText: A hometown folk hero already! The folding chairs are crying happy tears.

choices.label: Velvet Society - tell me about those wax seals.
choices.playerSpokenText: Midnight bookshops and crimson wax seals? Point me toward the Velvet Society before I die of boredom.
choices.rivalReplyText: Dangerous taste. Their underground salons break normal TV rules - and drop the rarest Lucky Charms in the game.
choices.hostReplyText: Ooh, eccentric high-IQ underground society! Remember to pinky-up when you buzz in.

beats.speaker: max_sterling
beats.text: Rough audition! Good news: on my show, losing never slams a dead Game Over wall in your face. It drops you onto the crimson-yarn Redemption Circuit.

beats.speaker: frankie_russo
beats.text: Slide into Booth Four, kid. Coffee's burnt, pie's fresh, and half the night shift plays for cash here at 2 AM. Beat my diner board and you're right back on Oakridge's main card.

choices.label: Deal the tiles - nobody keeps me down twice.
choices.playerSpokenText: Pour the burnt coffee and deal the tiles, Frankie. That tryout was just me checking the mic.
choices.rivalReplyText: That's the Brooklyn grit I like to see! Let's wake up the fry cook.
choices.hostReplyText: A comeback story starts with cheap coffee and zero fear!

choices.label: Thanks for not letting my run end in the rain.
choices.playerSpokenText: Appreciate you pulling me into Booth Four, Frankie. I owe you a real match.
choices.rivalReplyText: Hey, I choked my first three pub nights back in 2018. Stick with it - you've got fast eyes.
choices.hostReplyText: Look at that: a rivalry turning into a midnight corner-man partnership.

choices.label: If I win, I'm taking the cherry pie too.
choices.playerSpokenText: Just so we're clear on the contract: my win purse includes a slice of that spinning-case cherry pie.
choices.rivalReplyText: Ha! Beat me under fluorescent bulbs and Lou will name a waffle after you.
choices.hostReplyText: High-stakes breakfast wagering! That's the Redemption Circuit magic.

beats.speaker: frankie_russo
beats.text: Rules in Lou's diner are simple: use your two-second Read-In, spin the brass dial cleanly, and prove you belong back on Oakridge's main stage.

beats.speaker: max_sterling
beats.text: Win here and you snag the Underdog Chip charm - +100 comeback bonus every time you rally from behind!

beats.speaker: frankie_russo
beats.text: Boom! Look at the night shift cheering! Pocket that Underdog Chip, kid - you just clawed right back onto Tuesday's main bracket.

beats.speaker: producer_sam
beats.text: Pin your new Polaroid onto the Tour Trunk and snap that Underdog Chip into a podium brass cup. Cinderella arcs sell twice as many tickets.

beats.speaker: max_sterling
beats.text: Your first true head-to-head! Frankie Russo has ruled forty-seven straight Tuesday nights on Pop Culture, Sports, and Food - just don't ask him to spell mitochondria.

beats.speaker: frankie_russo
beats.text: Hey, I know plenty of science! Mostly how long ice lasts in a rocks glass. Ready to see why nobody takes my microphone?

choices.label: Hope you brushed up on Physics, bartender.
choices.playerSpokenText: I'm steering this whole board straight into Science and Logic, Frankie. Hope you brought a lab coat.
choices.rivalReplyText: Low blow! Alright, gloves off - I'm claiming every Sports and Cinema tile before you blink.
choices.hostReplyText: Tactical warfare in a rec center! Watch those Science columns.

choices.label: Forty-seven straight is legendary. Bring it.
choices.playerSpokenText: Forty-seven straight wins is no fluke, Frankie. Teach me how Oakridge plays.
choices.rivalReplyText: Now you're talking! Watch the Crown Wedge tiles - light up that six-color medallion early.
choices.hostReplyText: Mutual respect and free tactical scouting! Frankie's getting soft on us.

choices.label: Mitochondria is the powerhouse of this pub.
choices.playerSpokenText: Don't sweat biology, Frankie - everyone knows the mitochondria is the powerhouse of the pretzel bowl.
choices.rivalReplyText: Hah! Okay, I'm stealing that line for Friday happy hour. Let's play!
choices.hostReplyText: Comedy gold on a folding-chair budget! Roll the first tile.

beats.speaker: producer_sam
beats.text: Welcome to your first Sponsor Showcase! Neighborhood station WOKR wants a live Showman Dare: throw the 2x Double Down switch and nail the answer while the Time-Bomb fuse ticks.

beats.speaker: max_sterling
beats.text: Win this booth blitz and you walk out with the Grassroots Megaphone charm - an extra brass Clue coin in every single future match!

scenes.title: Defuse the Fuse in Red Hook

beats.speaker: max_sterling
beats.text: Smell that hops and ozone? This brewery play-in runs our Time-Bomb Hot Potato twist: one tile on the board has a live burning fuse.

beats.speaker: producer_sam
beats.text: Defuse the ticking tile fast for bonus voltage before it jumps and scorches your score. Clear the taproom and your main-stage comeback stays alive!

beats.speaker: max_sterling
beats.text: Notice the glossy crimson dome bolted onto your podium? That is the SCREW RIVAL! buzzer - inspired by the finest traditions of petty television.

beats.speaker: max_sterling
beats.text: Once per match, slam SCREW RIVAL! on an open tile you suspect Frankie hates, forcing HIM to answer live. If he chokes, you steal 100% of the tile. If he nails it, he pockets the cash and gloats.

beats.speaker: frankie_russo
beats.text: Hey, wait a second - I got a red dome on my podium too! Touch my Chemistry column and I'm slamming yours straight into 1970s baseball stats!

choices.label: Save your breath - I'm hitting Science first.
choices.playerSpokenText: Keep your eye on the 800-point Science tile, Frankie. My palm's already hovering over the red dome.
choices.rivalReplyText: Oh, you ruthless little shark! Fine - let's see how you like a fastball from my side of the board.
choices.hostReplyText: Brass sparks flying already! Watch out for each other's Screw tokens.

choices.label: Fair warning - I'll only press it when it counts.
choices.playerSpokenText: No cheap shots, Frankie. If I slam that red button, you'll know I respected your lead enough to need it.
choices.rivalReplyText: Respect! Though between us, if an Astrophysics tile pops up, I'd slam it on me too.
choices.hostReplyText: Honest rivalry at its finest! Let's light up the hall.

choices.label: Who installed an arcade button on oak mahogany?
choices.playerSpokenText: Honestly, I just admire whoever bolted a nuclear launch button onto a community-center podium.
choices.rivalReplyText: That was Sam with a cordless drill twenty minutes ago! Now quit stalling and pick a tile!
choices.hostReplyText: Zero OSHA violations on this stage, folks - purely theatrical chaos!

scenes.title: Wax Seal Behind the Bookshop
scenes.locationSubhead: Aldine Rare Books Back Parlor - Secret Velvet Salon

beats.speaker: max_sterling
beats.text: Lower your voice - you just slipped through a sliding bookcase into a Secret Velvet Society Salon. Tonight's board runs Velvet X-Crossroads: both glowing diagonals pay double.

beats.speaker: denise_park
beats.text: So you're the pub prodigy everyone whispered about. Sit up straight, keep your elbows off the baize, and let's see if you know anything older than last Tuesday's box office.

choices.label: I'll skip the lecture and take the diagonal sweep.
choices.playerSpokenText: Save the syllabus for downtown, Denise. I'm taking both 2x diagonals and the Velvet purse.
choices.rivalReplyText: My, such bold posture for someone who hasn't survived a single nineteenth-century treaty clue yet.
choices.hostReplyText: Candlelight and ice-cold stares! The Velvet patrons are eating this up.

choices.label: An honor to share a salon table with a legend.
choices.playerSpokenText: Thirty-four years teaching AP History, Ms. Park - I'll consider tonight an advanced seminar.
choices.rivalReplyText: Proper address AND attentive posture! Perhaps the neighborhood circuit isn't entirely hopeless after all.
choices.hostReplyText: Look at that faint smile - you just earned an A-minus before question one.

choices.label: Is there a pop-quiz penalty for bad grammar?
choices.playerSpokenText: Quick question: if I win with 'less' mistakes instead of 'fewer', do you dock my score?
choices.rivalReplyText: I'll dock your pride, dear - and yes, it is strictly 'fewer'. Charming nerve, though.
choices.hostReplyText: Grammar warfare by candlelight! Clear those diagonals without lifelines for the Velvet bonus.

beats.speaker: frankie_russo
beats.text: Chairs are up on the tables, kid. Just you, me, and a fresh padlocked practice board before the big Oakridge final. Beat me here and my embossed Lucky Coaster goes straight onto your podium.

beats.speaker: max_sterling
beats.text: Frankie's Lucky Coaster is pure gold: your very first missed 2x Double Down in any match loses ZERO points. Play bold without the bruise!

choices.label: I don't plan on missing - hand it over anyway.
choices.playerSpokenText: I'm taking that coaster as a trophy, Frankie, even if I never need the safety net.
choices.rivalReplyText: Cocky to the bone! Earn it on the wood then - let's run the practice rack.

choices.label: You're the best corner-man in Brooklyn, Frankie.
choices.playerSpokenText: Keeping the taproom open to drill me? Win or lose, you're coming with me to the big leagues.
choices.rivalReplyText: Aw, shut up before I tear up into the limes. Here - take the Lucky Coaster right now, and still try to beat my score!

choices.label: Is this coaster magically immune to ring stains?
choices.playerSpokenText: Does Frankie's Lucky Coaster also protect mahogany podiums from nervous sweat?
choices.rivalReplyText: Guaranteed since 1998! Beat me tonight and I'll polish the brass rim myself.

beats.speaker: producer_sam
beats.text: Every time the express train shakes the ceiling, a Time-Bomb tile flickers. Last wildcard seat into the Oakridge Crown Showdown - leave nothing on the table!

beats.speaker: frankie_russo
beats.text: You got more lives than an alley cat, kid. Show the basement crowd you're ready for my main stage!

beats.speaker: max_sterling
beats.text: Look at this room! A hundred and eighty neighbors jammed past the folding chairs, a cable van idling out front, and chained 800-point vaults guarding Oakridge's belt!

beats.speaker: frankie_russo
beats.text: Apron's off, towel's folded, and the whole block bet their rent on a classic. Take my belt if you can, kid - I ain't handing it over cheap!

choices.label: Make room in the trophy case - it's coming with me.
choices.playerSpokenText: Tell the cable van to keep rolling, Frankie. Tonight a new name owns Oakridge.
choices.rivalReplyText: Ooh, big talk under bright lights! Let's shatter some iron chains and settle it!
choices.hostReplyText: Electric energy in Brooklyn! Shatter those adjacent locks and chase three Jewel Wedges!

choices.label: Whatever happens, Oakridge wins tonight.
choices.playerSpokenText: You built this room from forty-two chairs into a circus, Frankie. Let's give everyone here a match for the ages.
choices.rivalReplyText: Now I'm proud to share the mic with ya. Alright - touch gloves and shatter that board!
choices.hostReplyText: Chills! Even the coffee urn stopped rattling to watch this showdown.

choices.label: Last call for the reigning champ!
choices.playerSpokenText: Check your watch, Frankie - looks like it's finally Last Call for the defending champ.
choices.rivalReplyText: Hah! Using my own nickname against me in my own building?! Oh, you're getting Screwed on turn two!
choices.hostReplyText: The crowd LOVES it! Hands on buzzers - the Oakridge Crown is live!

beats.speaker: frankie_russo
beats.text: Well I'll be! You actually took the belt right off my apron. Don't forget these folding chairs when the velvet balconies hit downtown - call me if you ever need backup!

beats.speaker: max_sterling
beats.text: From a rainy sidewalk to Oakridge Champion! Pack your Tour Trunk - next stop is the Downtown Lyric Theater, fourteen hundred velvet seats, and a chamber symphony warming up in the pit.

beats.speaker: frankie_russo
beats.text: Still the king of Oakridge! Hey - keep your chin up, kid. You pushed me closer to the cliff than anybody in six years.

beats.speaker: producer_sam
beats.text: Good news: the civic cable truck loved your fire. Channel 56's basement wildcard goes live in an hour - win there and you storm straight into Downtown Lyric Theater through the back door!

beats.speaker: max_sterling
beats.text: Right between local polka and an earnest puppet show, welcome to the Channel 56 Wildcard! Defuse the Time-Bomb tiles and claim your velvet seat at the Lyric.

beats.speaker: max_sterling
beats.text: Smell that mahogany polish and rosin? Hear the chamber strings tuning below the apron? Welcome to the Downtown Lyric Theater - and meet its undisputed dean, Denise Park!

beats.speaker: denise_park
beats.text: Welcome to my classroom, challenger. Notice the heavy iron chains and brass padlocks binding the 400 and 800-point vaults? You do NOT skip straight to the thesis without passing the prerequisites.

beats.speaker: max_sterling
beats.text: That's 3D Chain-Reaction Padlocks in action! Solve any open neighboring tile and lightning arcs straight into adjacent locks, shattering those brass chains in flying sparks!

choices.label: Watch me shatter your syllabus in five turns.
choices.playerSpokenText: Keep your red pen capped, Denise. I'm blowing through those padlocks and rewriting the city record.
choices.rivalReplyText: Bravado rarely survives a primary-source History question, dear. Take your seat at the podium.
choices.hostReplyText: Ooh, sharp brass chords from the pit! The balcony is loving this tension.

choices.label: I did the reading, Ms. Park. Test me.
choices.playerSpokenText: Thirty-four years of discipline against a neighborhood rookie - I did my homework, Ms. Park.
choices.rivalReplyText: Refreshingly prepared! Remember: break locks beside your strongest category first, and keep your posture straight.
choices.hostReplyText: A tactical tip from Denise Park herself?! Somebody alert the City Gazette!

choices.label: Do shattered padlocks count as extra credit?
choices.playerSpokenText: Quick grading policy check: if my chain reaction shatters three padlocks at once, do I get extra credit?
choices.rivalReplyText: Only if your spelling holds up under pressure! Clever retort - I'll allow an A-minus for spirit.
choices.hostReplyText: Sharp wit echoing off velvet balconies! Break open those chains!

scenes.title: The Apex Network Suit
scenes.locationSubhead: Lyric Mezzanine Press Lounge - 2100 Cable Streamers

beats.speaker: producer_sam
beats.text: Good news or a trap, depending on your soul: Apex Network's talent scouts loved your Oakridge clips. They booked a Spotlight Roulette screen test right here in the mezzanine.

beats.speaker: max_sterling
beats.text: On a Spotlight Roulette board, the overhead beam occasionally spins wild and forces your next tile. Chain a four-answer hot streak on camera and Apex drops a $900 Showman Dare bonus!

choices.label: Tell Apex to print my headshot bigger.
choices.playerSpokenText: Roll tape and get my good side. I'll hit their four-streak dare and take every dime they're offering.
choices.rivalReplyText: Music to corporate ears. Just remember: Apex loves drama even more than dignity.

choices.label: I'll take the screen test, not the leash.
choices.playerSpokenText: I'll play their spotlight board fair and square, Sam - but nobody scripts what I say at the mic.
choices.rivalReplyText: Smart boundaries. Keep the check, keep your voice.

choices.label: Only if the Spotlight hits my best angles.
choices.playerSpokenText: Forced spotlight jumps? Fine, just tell the lighting guy I look deeply intellectual in sapphire.
choices.rivalReplyText: Ha! The Velvet scouts in the corner just scribbled your name in fountain ink too.

beats.speaker: denise_park
beats.text: Stumbled under the Lyric chandelier? Nonsense - even Churchill bombed an early speech. Meet me in the reading room; shatter these practice locks and earn your Lyric rematch.

beats.speaker: max_sterling
beats.text: Whisper-quiet stacks, thunderous chain shatters! Nail this comeback board and jump right back into the city race.

beats.speaker: max_sterling
beats.text: Fresh board twist tonight: Pyramid Ascent! Only the broad base row sits unlocked - every tile you conquer cracks the stone above it until the golden Apex Vault opens.

beats.speaker: denise_park
beats.text: Foundation first, summit second - precisely how civilization works. Watch my Sort-4 timelines, challenger; I've memorized every century since Rome.

scenes.title: Channel 7 Crashes the Stage Door
scenes.locationSubhead: Lyric Stage Door - Live Local Broadcast

beats.speaker: trevor_blake
beats.text: Careful looking straight at my smile under these bulbs! My dentist calls it Broadcast White. Heard a pub rookie was making noise downtown, so I brought Channel 7's camera truck to ruin the fairy tale early!

beats.speaker: max_sterling
beats.text: Unscheduled exhibition ambush! Trevor's hijacked a Time-Bomb Hot Potato board live for four thousand afternoon viewers. Show daytime TV you don't flinch!

choices.label: Better check your parking spot - I'm coming for Day 15.
choices.playerSpokenText: Enjoy that painted studio parking spot while it lasts, Trevor. Your streak ends the second I hit Channel 7.
choices.rivalReplyText: Ooh, cameras get that?! Producers, clip that soundbite for the promo reel - this kid's writing checks their brain can't cash!
choices.hostReplyText: Instant ratings wildfire! The cable truck just doubled its bandwidth.

choices.label: Fourteen straight on live TV takes serious nerve.
choices.playerSpokenText: Fourteen straight afternoons on live television isn't luck, Trevor. Let's give your viewers a real preview.
choices.rivalReplyText: Whoa - actual manners from a challenger? Almost makes me feel bad about burying you before the noon weather.
choices.hostReplyText: Even Trevor's hairspray relaxed a millimeter! Let's light the Time-Bomb.

choices.label: Did your dentist sign a waiver for that glare?
choices.playerSpokenText: Should I put on sunglasses before we start, or is Broadcast White rated safe for indoor viewing?
choices.rivalReplyText: Hah! Okay, writers' room, steal that joke - just don't expect mercy when the fuse jumps!
choices.hostReplyText: Quickest tongue since Cookie Masterson! Stage lights hot - let's roll!

scenes.title: Mezzanine Box Zero
scenes.locationSubhead: Lyric Clocktower Private Box - Velvet Salon

beats.speaker: max_sterling
beats.text: Above the chandelier sits Box Zero - and our Spiral Labyrinth board! Cut inward from the outer perimeter tiles to crack the blazing thousand-point Core.

beats.speaker: denise_park
beats.text: Conquer this spiral and the Society awards the Velvet Wax Seal - granting a SECOND Screw Rival token in every match. Use such mischief responsibly, dear.

scenes.title: Office Hours: Red Ink & Respect
scenes.locationSubhead: Lyric Rehearsal Hall - Before Dress Rehearsal

beats.speaker: denise_park
beats.text: Sit down. Before the City Championship curtain rises, I want to know whether you rely on flash or true mastery. Beat my rehearsal rack and you earn my Red Fountain Pen.

beats.speaker: producer_sam
beats.text: Trust me, you want Denise's Red Pen on your podium: it automatically crosses out one wrong choice on every History and Literature question!

choices.label: Grade me on the scoreboard, not the syllabus.
choices.playerSpokenText: I didn't come to pass a midterm, Denise - I came to win ten million dollars. Set up the board.
choices.rivalReplyText: Fierce, impatient, and slightly terrifying. Very well - show me what ambition looks like.

choices.label: You've made me sharper every single round.
choices.playerSpokenText: Honestly, Ms. Park, nobody's pushed my mind harder since high school. I'd be honored to carry your pen to television.
choices.rivalReplyText: Oh, stop - you'll ruin my stern reputation. Take the Red Fountain Pen now, and promise you'll still beat me cleanly on stage.

choices.label: Will it fix my split infinitives on live TV?
choices.playerSpokenText: If I equip Denise's Red Pen, does it zap me whenever I casually split an infinitive on camera?
choices.rivalReplyText: I certainly hope so! Crisp phrasing, crisp timing - now step up and earn it.

beats.speaker: producer_sam
beats.text: Commuters are stopping mid-stride to watch the concourse monitors! Ride this Spotlight Roulette wildcard straight into the Lyric City Championship.

beats.speaker: trevor_blake
beats.text: Still fighting through the late-night bracket? Hey, I respect the hustle - just try not to miss the train to real television!

beats.speaker: max_sterling
beats.text: Sixty-five hundred live and cable viewers, brass spotlights cutting the velvet, and strings soaring from the pit! Win tonight and your passport to live Channel 7 television is signed in ink!

beats.speaker: denise_park
beats.text: Twenty tiles, iron padlocks, and six formats standing between Oakridge and television. Stand tall, challenger - give this grand old theater a finale worthy of its rafters.

choices.label: Television starts tonight - class dismissed.
choices.playerSpokenText: You taught a great masterclass, Denise, but the bell just rang. I'm taking Channel 7 tonight.
choices.rivalReplyText: Using my own catchphrase under my own chandelier? Bold move - let's see if your recall matches your nerve!
choices.hostReplyText: Symphony brass at full volume! Let the City Championship begin!

choices.label: Save me a front-row seat when we hit TV.
choices.playerSpokenText: Win or lose, sharing this stage with you made me a real contender, Denise. Keep your posture tall.
choices.rivalReplyText: Splendid grace under the lights! Now forget sentiment for twelve turns and show me brilliance.
choices.hostReplyText: Not a dry eye in the mezzanine! Shatter those locks and claim the city crown!

choices.label: No pop quizzes on the Channel 7 shuttle, deal?
choices.playerSpokenText: Deal's simple: if I win the Lyric Crown, you promise zero surprise grammar quizzes on the ride to Studio B.
choices.rivalReplyText: Ha! Beat me across six formats and I'll even let you end a sentence with a preposition. Once.
choices.hostReplyText: Historical linguistic concessions on live cable! Fire up the board!

scenes.title: Television Calling
scenes.locationSubhead: Lyric Stage Door - Act I Victory

beats.speaker: denise_park
beats.text: Extraordinary work! Put me down for a front-row ticket when you hit television - and for heaven's sake, keep your shoulders back when Trevor Blake tries his cheap camera tricks.

beats.speaker: max_sterling
beats.text: From forty-two folding chairs in the rain to City Champion! Your Channel 7 boarding pass is stamped - seventy-eight thousand daytime viewers are about to learn your name!

beats.speaker: producer_sam
beats.text: Act II is unlocked on your Tour Trunk! Grab your Lucky Charms - Trevor '14-Day' Blake is already hogging the makeup mirror at Studio B.

scenes.title: The 3 AM Satellite Detour
scenes.locationSubhead: Channel 7 Parking Lot - Act II Redemption Entry

beats.speaker: denise_park
beats.text: Class dismissed - by a razor-thin margin! Take this red-penciled scouting card anyway; Channel 7 needs someone with actual substance.

beats.speaker: producer_sam
beats.text: No dead ends here! I traded three favors to land you Channel 7's 3 AM Infomercial-Slot Scramble. Claw out of the graveyard shift and hijack Trevor's daytime ratings anyway!

beats.speaker: max_sterling
beats.text: Seventy-eight thousand lunch breaks just stopped chewing! Welcome to Channel 7 Studio B, where studio brass is blazing and the board runs Tug-of-War Territory Turf!

beats.speaker: max_sterling
beats.text: Here is the turf twist: every tile you claim paints studio territory in your color. Hold the majority of the board when the clock hits zero and bank a massive +500 Territory Bonus!

beats.speaker: trevor_blake
beats.text: Fourteen straight afternoons on Channel 7, baby! Wave to Oakridge before the commercial break - my smile owns more square footage in this studio than the weather map.

choices.label: Enjoy the noon weather - a cold front just arrived.
choices.playerSpokenText: Hope the Channel 7 weatherman warned you, Trevor - I'm claiming every column on this floor.
choices.rivalReplyText: Ooh, studio crowd went 'oooooh'! Somebody get me extra powder, we're going viral before 1 PM!
choices.hostReplyText: Pure daytime television electricity! Claim that turf!

choices.label: You built this audience - let's earn their cheers.
choices.playerSpokenText: You're the reason seventy-eight thousand people tune in at lunch, Trevor. Let's give them a clean war.
choices.rivalReplyText: Wait, stop saying nice things on live TV! You're messing up my villain edit!
choices.hostReplyText: Breaking news: Trevor Blake almost blushed through bronze stage makeup!

choices.label: Is hairspray taxed separately from the $8,000 purse?
choices.playerSpokenText: Quick network accounting question: does your hairspray budget come out of my $8,000 winner's check?
choices.rivalReplyText: Hey, this volume is an investment in broadcast journalism! Wait till I steal your turf!
choices.hostReplyText: The cameraman is shaking from laughing! Lights hot - take your first tile!

scenes.title: Static, Coffee & Frankie on Speakerphone
scenes.locationSubhead: Channel 7 Parking Lot - Satellite Van #4 (3:00 AM)

beats.speaker: producer_sam
beats.text: You're live between a miracle-mop commercial and 3 AM jazz. Defuse this Time-Bomb board in the satellite van and you're back in Studio B by lunchtime.

beats.speaker: frankie_russo
beats.text: Yo, kid! Just finished wiping the bar in Oakridge and saw you on Channel 7's graveyard feed! Don't sweat Trevor's teeth - hammer Science and Arts, he folds like a cheap lawn chair!

choices.label: Watch me hijack the morning news by sunrise.
choices.playerSpokenText: Keep the TV on behind the bar, Frankie. I'm burning through this satellite bracket before dawn.
choices.rivalReplyText: Atta kid! Whole neighborhood's staying up past last call for ya!

choices.label: Hearing Oakridge on the line means everything.
choices.playerSpokenText: Thanks for calling at 3 AM, Frankie. That scouting tip on Science and Arts just saved my week.
choices.rivalReplyText: Hey, Oakridge sticks together! Now go defuse that clock and get your daytime seat back.

choices.label: Should I buy a miracle mop while I'm live?
choices.playerSpokenText: Honestly, if I sweep this van board, I'm ordering three miracle mops on the network tab.
choices.rivalReplyText: Hah! Send one to Brooklyn - the radiator leaked again. Go get 'em!

beats.speaker: producer_sam
beats.text: Apex Network brass just slid a fresh Call Sheet under our dressing-room door. Nail a 2x Double Down dare on their Spotlight Roulette set and they'll pay $4,500 extra on top of the purse.

beats.speaker: max_sterling
beats.text: Even sweeter: win this showcase and you unlock the Syndicate Golden Dice charm - boosting EVERY future Power Play wager payout by +25%!

beats.speaker: max_sterling
beats.text: Over a hundred thousand viewers live for our Spiral Labyrinth broadcast! Start at the outer studio rim, wind inward through fogged corridors, and crack the blazing thousand-point Core!

beats.speaker: trevor_blake
beats.text: Camera Two, stay tight on my jawline while I carve a straight path into that center jackpot. Try not to get dizzy out on the cheap outer tiles, rookie!

beats.speaker: denise_park
beats.text: Yes, I took the commuter train to Newark at midnight because I refused to watch Trevor Blake strut across television unchecked. Sit up straight - we're climbing a Pyramid Ascent comeback!

beats.speaker: max_sterling
beats.text: When your toughest Tier 2 rival shows up in a Newark UHF studio to drill your timelines, you know this tournament just got personal!

choices.label: Watch me tear down Trevor's set by Friday.
choices.playerSpokenText: Give me twenty minutes on this Pyramid board, Denise - by Friday Trevor won't have a streak left to brag about.
choices.rivalReplyText: Properly fierce! Just make sure your ambition remembers the dates of the Renaissance.

choices.label: Thank you for making the trip, Ms. Park.
choices.playerSpokenText: You took a midnight train just to coach me out of Redemption? I'm never forgetting this, Denise.
choices.rivalReplyText: Good teachers never abandon a promising scholar mid-semester. Now go dismantle that daytime peacock!

choices.label: Is Newark UHF officially on the AP syllabus?
choices.playerSpokenText: Tell me honestly: did you grade the station manager's grammar on the way through security?
choices.rivalReplyText: He wrote 'there studio' on a whiteboard, dear - I had no choice but to intervene in red ink!

beats.speaker: trevor_blake
beats.text: Hey producers, zoom in tight! I checked your Career Stats backstage, found your absolute worst category, and my hand is resting right on my red SCREW RIVAL! dome!

beats.speaker: max_sterling
beats.text: Sweeps Week pettiness at its peak! Remember: Trevor hates Science and Fine Arts - slam YOUR red dome on one of those tiles and steal his lunch money on live TV!

choices.label: Go ahead - watch me nail your trap and Screw you back.
choices.playerSpokenText: Drop your worst category on me, Trevor. I'll answer it clean and slam an Art History bomb straight back onto your podium.
choices.rivalReplyText: Ooh, the floor director just fainted from pure drama! Bring it, Sweeps Week!
choices.hostReplyText: Apex Network executives are weeping tears of Nielsen joy!

choices.label: Smart homework, Trevor - now brace for mine.
choices.playerSpokenText: Checking my career radar backstage is sharp gamesmanship, Trevor. Just don't assume I skipped studying yours.
choices.rivalReplyText: Wait - you studied MY stats?! Okay, slight sweat forming under the collar now.
choices.hostReplyText: Chess with buzzers! Territory Turf and Screw tokens live!

choices.label: Careful - slamming that button might smudge your tan.
choices.playerSpokenText: Hit the red dome gently, Trevor - wouldn't want spray-tan residue messing up Channel 7's circuitry.
choices.rivalReplyText: That is 100% organic Orlando sunlight, pal, and I'm about to bury you on live broadcast!
choices.hostReplyText: Shots fired across Studio B! Let the Sweeps Week battle begin!

scenes.title: Midnight in the Glass Conservatory
scenes.locationSubhead: Botanical Club Atrium - Secret Velvet Salon

beats.speaker: max_sterling
beats.text: Orchids, moonlight, and Velvet X-Crossroads - where both diagonals pay double. And stepping across the conservatory tile in pressed surgical scrubs is Starlight Prime-Time's reigning ace, Dr. Priya Nair!

beats.speaker: priya_nair
beats.text: Just finished a twelve-hour Boston ER shift on four hours of sleep. Thought I'd relax by seeing whether the Oakridge sensation survives Velvet rules without a single lifeline.

choices.label: Save the stethoscope - your lead's about to flatline.
choices.playerSpokenText: Hope you brought caffeine, Doctor. I'm sweeping both Velvet diagonals before you finish checking my vitals.
choices.rivalReplyText: Bold diagnosis for someone who hasn't seen my recall speed in Science and Logic. Let's check your pulse.
choices.hostReplyText: Ice-cold composure meeting unstoppable swagger under the glass dome!

choices.label: Twelve hours in trauma and still sharp? True respect.
choices.playerSpokenText: Walking off an ER shift straight into a midnight Velvet Salon takes superhuman focus, Dr. Nair. Honored to share this board.
choices.rivalReplyText: Thank you. Honestly, thirty seconds on a brass shot clock feels like a vacation compared to Friday night triage. Shall we?
choices.hostReplyText: Genuine admiration between future prime-time titans!

choices.label: Do you solve Sunday crosswords in surgical ink too?
choices.playerSpokenText: Rumor says you finish Sunday crosswords in pen during coffee breaks - please tell me you at least blink occasionally.
choices.rivalReplyText: Once every ninety seconds, strictly between clues. Sharp ears - let's see if your buzzers match your wit.
choices.hostReplyText: Two brilliant minds clashing by moonlight! Clear those diagonals!

scenes.title: Studio B After Sign-Off
scenes.locationSubhead: Channel 7 Studio B - Work Lights Only

beats.speaker: trevor_blake
beats.text: Cameras are off, studio's empty. Look - before this streak, I was selling discount mattresses at 2 AM in Orlando. I'm not giving up this desk without knowing you're the real deal. Beat me off-air and my vintage Hot Mic is yours.

beats.speaker: producer_sam
beats.text: Trevor's Hot Mic adds +75 bonus heat to every hot-streak answer on your podium! Worth every ounce of off-air grit.

choices.label: Only room for one headliner on Channel 7.
choices.playerSpokenText: No hard feelings, Trevor, but prime-time doesn't hand out participation trophies. Let's run the board.
choices.rivalReplyText: Fair enough! Cold as studio AC - let's settle it under the work lights.

choices.label: You earned this desk from scratch - I respect the grind.
choices.playerSpokenText: From 2 AM mattress ads to fourteen straight days on Channel 7? You're an underdog too, Trevor. Let's play our hearts out.
choices.rivalReplyText: Man... nobody at Apex ever says that. Take my Hot Mic right now - and if you beat me tomorrow, go wreck prime-time for both of us.

choices.label: To be fair, your mattress pitch probably sold out.
choices.playerSpokenText: With a Broadcast White smile like yours, I bet Orlando ran completely out of queen-size pillow-tops.
choices.rivalReplyText: Ha! Moved forty-two Sertas in one weekend, pal! Alright - fire up the board!

beats.speaker: producer_sam
beats.text: Live from a regional broadcast truck off the turnpike! Survive this Time-Bomb qualifier and you earn the Screw Shield charm - blocking one Rival Screw or Column Freeze every single match!

beats.speaker: trevor_blake
beats.text: Hey, if you claw out of a highway truck and win a Screw Shield, even I have to applaud. Good luck catching the fuse!

beats.speaker: max_sterling
beats.text: Two hundred and forty thousand viewers tuned in for Day Fifteen! Tonight's Championship Board runs full Spotlight Roulette - overhead searchlights spin wild and force dramatic tile jumps live on air!

beats.speaker: trevor_blake
beats.text: Fourteen straight days, twenty-five thousand dollars on the desk, and a ticket to National Prime-Time waiting backstage. Show me if Oakridge can dance when the spotlight spins!

choices.label: Day Fifteen belongs to me - pack up your mug.
choices.playerSpokenText: Grab a cardboard box for your Channel 7 mug, Trevor. Your streak stops cold in twelve turns.
choices.rivalReplyText: Oh, the audience just gasped so loud the boom mic clipped! Let's spin that spotlight!
choices.hostReplyText: Daytime television history about to be written live!

choices.label: Fourteen days is iconic - let's make Day 15 unforgettable.
choices.playerSpokenText: Whatever the scoreboard says in ten minutes, nobody's topping this streak battle, Trevor.
choices.rivalReplyText: Appreciate that, champ-in-waiting. Now let's blow the roof off Channel 7!
choices.hostReplyText: Electric poise under blinding studio wattage! Roll Day Fifteen!

choices.label: Don't worry - I hear the Channel 7 tote bag is nice.
choices.playerSpokenText: Look on the bright side, Trevor: if I end the streak today, at least you've got fifteen Channel 7 tote bags.
choices.rivalReplyText: Hah! Actually they only give you ONE tote bag, which is criminal! Now watch me sweep!
choices.hostReplyText: Comedic gold right before a $25,000 showdown! Spotlight spinning!

beats.speaker: trevor_blake
beats.text: Wait, my streak is actually over?! Hand me a tissue - and honestly, go crush Starlight Prime-Time so I can brag on every podcast that I only lost to The World's Smartest!

beats.speaker: max_sterling
beats.text: The clip just hit five million views before the evening news! Grab your tuxedo - Starlight Broadcast Center booked you for Eight O'Clock Eastern, backed by a full prime-time symphony orchestra!

scenes.title: Red-Eye to Prime-Time
scenes.locationSubhead: Terminal B Airport Lounge - Coast-to-Coast Play-In

beats.speaker: trevor_blake
beats.text: Day Fifteen in the books! Hey - keep that chin high, rookie. Half of Twitter is screaming for a rematch already.

beats.speaker: producer_sam
beats.text: That nail-biter went viral coast to coast! Starlight's producers gave us an emergency midnight Red-Eye Play-In at Terminal B - win through the Fog Spotlight and crash Eight O'Clock Prime-Time anyway!

scenes.title: Fog Over the Tarmac
scenes.locationSubhead: Terminal B Satellite Desk - 820,000 Live Streamers

beats.speaker: max_sterling
beats.text: Midnight fog on the runway and Fog-of-War Spotlight on the board! Only the center tiles glow lit - every answer illuminates neighboring clues through the mist until your path to Prime-Time is clear!

scenes.title: Eight O'Clock Eastern
scenes.locationSubhead: Starlight Broadcast Center - 5.2 Million Watching Live

beats.speaker: max_sterling
beats.text: Five point two million households coast to coast, sweeping jib cranes, and a full symphony brass overture! Welcome to Starlight Prime-Time - and tonight's sizzling twist: Gold Fever Contagion!

beats.speaker: max_sterling
beats.text: String answers into a hot streak and golden fever spreads straight into adjacent tiles, supercharging them with contagious 2x glow! Standing opposite you: Boston ER legend Dr. Priya Nair!

beats.speaker: priya_nair
beats.text: Oakridge to Starlight in one season - impressive vitals, challenger. Nothing personal, I just prefer fast buzzers, zero panic, and a surgical victory before the nine o'clock drama.

choices.label: Hope you prepped the ER - I'm bringing Gold Fever.
choices.playerSpokenText: Steady hands won't save you once my Gold Fever streak catches fire across this whole stage, Doctor.
choices.rivalReplyText: A fever spike on live television? Good thing I'm board-certified in cooling overheated challengers down.
choices.hostReplyText: Five million couches just sat bolt upright! Prime-Time is LIVE!

choices.label: Facing the sharpest mind in America is why I came.
choices.playerSpokenText: You're the gold standard of prime-time, Dr. Nair. Let's give five million people a masterclass.
choices.rivalReplyText: Calm pulse, sharp eyes. Honestly, you'd hold up brilliantly on a Friday night trauma floor. Good luck.
choices.hostReplyText: Pure class under ten-thousand-watt arc lamps! Let's ignite the board!

choices.label: Does health insurance cover getting Screwed on TV?
choices.playerSpokenText: Quick medical question before tip-off: is getting hit by a red SCREW RIVAL! buzzer covered in-network?
choices.rivalReplyText: Only if you survive the Science column first. Crisp bedside humor - let's begin!
choices.hostReplyText: Even the symphonic conductor cracked a grin! Stage hot!

beats.speaker: producer_sam
beats.text: Apex Network dropped fifty-five grand on the table for a prime-time stunt board: Power-Play Minefield! Four concealed Power-Play wagers are buried under those brass tiles.

beats.speaker: max_sterling
beats.text: Uncover one, spin the brass wager dial, and stick the answer live to pocket an extra $18,000 Showman Dare bonus! Fortune favors the fearless.

beats.speaker: trevor_blake
beats.text: Look who bumped the stand-up comedian off the midnight slot! Defuse this Time-Bomb board beside me and you're right back in Dr. Nair's prime-time crosshairs.

beats.speaker: max_sterling
beats.text: Even when you stumble in prime time, America refuses to change the channel! Own this midnight comeback!

beats.speaker: priya_nair
beats.text: Pyramid Ascent at eight million viewers. Watch closely: I'm racing straight up the Biology and Logic flank before you even unlock row three.

beats.speaker: max_sterling
beats.text: Hint from your favorite host: Priya rarely watches Sports or Food television - steer the pyramid base there and watch her frown for the first time all season!

beats.speaker: max_sterling
beats.text: Welcome to your first sprawling SIX-COLUMN championship stage - and our dazzling Ice & Fire Columns twist! When a rival freezes your favorite lane solid, hunt down a blazing Flame tile!

beats.speaker: max_sterling
beats.text: Nail that Flame tile to shatter the frost across the entire frozen column AND pocket a scorching +200 Thaw Bonus!

beats.speaker: priya_nair
beats.text: Putting your strongest column in quarantine is standard triage, challenger. Show ten million people how fast you thaw under pressure.

scenes.title: The Visitor from Oxford
scenes.locationSubhead: Starlight Penthouse Library - Transatlantic Velvet Salon

beats.speaker: max_sterling
beats.text: Fifty floors above the studio roar, the Velvet Society flew in a surprise transatlantic guest for a Fog-of-War exhibition: Oxford Classics Fellow Lord Alistair Finch - London's Tier 5 champion!

beats.speaker: alistair_finch
beats.text: Do forgive me if I blink at American stage lighting; I still regard television as a loud passing fad. Still, rumors of a Brooklyn prodigy reached Oxford - let us clear a little fog together.

choices.label: Save your scones - I'm sweeping London next.
choices.playerSpokenText: Enjoy the scouting trip, Alistair. Next week I'm flying across the Atlantic and taking your Rotunda too.
choices.rivalReplyText: Good heavens, colonials never do whisper, do they? Delightfully brash - let us see if your History survives the fog.
choices.hostReplyText: Atlantic sparks flying a whole Act early! Watch out for Alistair's Arts and History traps.

choices.label: An honor to test myself against Oxford's finest.
choices.playerSpokenText: Crossing an ocean just to share a candlelit Fog board? Truly honored, Lord Finch.
choices.rivalReplyText: Splendid manners! Perhaps the rumors understated you. Mind the Classical Literature tiles - I rarely miss them.
choices.hostReplyText: You just made a powerful friend ahead of Act III London!

choices.label: Wait till you see our Pop Culture questions, Lord Finch.
choices.playerSpokenText: No offense to ancient Greece, Alistair, but wait until a 1990s boy-band clue pops out of this fog.
choices.rivalReplyText: Dear me, what a barbaric threat! Though I confess I did once hear a Spice Girls record by accident.
choices.hostReplyText: Oxford dry wit meets Brooklyn cheek! Illuminate the Penthouse Fog!

scenes.title: Grand Rounds in Dressing Room Four
scenes.locationSubhead: Starlight Backstage - Before the National Finale

beats.speaker: priya_nair
beats.text: Black coffee, two buzzers, and zero cameras before the National Finale. Grandmaster Viktor Volkov has held the World Crown three straight years - whoever boards that London flight has to be razor-sharp.

beats.speaker: producer_sam
beats.text: Win this backstage speed duel and Dr. Nair awards Priya's Adrenaline Patch - delivering a massive +120 clutch bonus whenever you lock in with five seconds or less!

choices.label: Volkov can wait - I'm going through you first.
choices.playerSpokenText: I'm not flying to London to make friends, Priya. Deal the tiles and let's see who breaks first.
choices.rivalReplyText: Pure adrenaline, zero hesitation. Alright - show me championship speed.

choices.label: Whoever wins tomorrow, Volkov won't see us coming.
choices.playerSpokenText: Training with you is the only way either of us catches Viktor Volkov in the Finale, Priya. Let's sharpen each other.
choices.rivalReplyText: Now THAT is the mind of a World Champion. Take my Adrenaline Patch right now - and let's still run this speed rack at full throttle!

choices.label: Is an Adrenaline Patch technically performance-enhancing?
choices.playerSpokenText: Just checking before legal shows up: is Priya's Adrenaline Patch approved by the International Trivia Board?
choices.rivalReplyText: Strictly espresso and steady nerves - completely legal on every continent. Now try to keep up!

beats.speaker: producer_sam
beats.text: Our transatlantic flight boards in forty minutes, and Apex set up two mahogany podiums right beside Gate 14! Win here to crash the Starlight Finale - or even on a thriller loss, grab the standby seat to London's Redemption Play-In!

beats.speaker: priya_nair
beats.text: Tug-of-War Turf beside an international boarding gate? Only on this show. Hold your nerve and claim the turf!

scenes.title: Fourteen Million Eyes: Ticket to London

beats.speaker: max_sterling
beats.text: Fourteen million viewers from Brooklyn to San Diego! Full symphony horns blasting, all SEVEN tactile formats live across six columns, Gold Fever Contagion blazing - and a first-class boarding pass to London's Grand Rotunda on the pedestal!

beats.speaker: producer_sam
beats.text: Quick backstage whisper in your ear: Oakridge Hall is packed wall-to-wall watching on a projector, Denise is grading your posture from row three, and Frankie already bet the bar tab on you!

beats.speaker: priya_nair
beats.text: Six columns, a hundred thousand dollars, and the whole country watching. No holding back, no wasted seconds - let's find out who deserves to face Europe!

choices.label: London's already got my name on the marquee.
choices.playerSpokenText: Fourteen million people are about to watch a coronation, Priya. Keep the jet engines warm for London.
choices.rivalReplyText: Bold words under prime-time wattage! Let's see if your recall holds up across all seven formats!
choices.hostReplyText: Thunderous brass fanfare! The National Prime-Time Finale is UNDERWAY!

choices.label: From Oakridge to Boston - let's give America a classic.
choices.playerSpokenText: Every mile from forty-two folding chairs led to this podium, Priya. Let's give fourteen million people a match they'll quote for years.
choices.rivalReplyText: I couldn't ask for a finer opponent under these lights. Steady breath - let's make television history.
choices.hostReplyText: Goosebumps across four time zones! Fourteen turns for $100,000 and London!

choices.label: If I win, I'm finally buying Oakridge a new coffee urn.
choices.playerSpokenText: Tell Brooklyn I promised them a brand-new coffee urn out of this $100,000 check - so no pressure, Doctor.
choices.rivalReplyText: Ha! Now I actually feel guilty trying to block Oakridge's caffeine upgrade. Almost. Let's play!
choices.hostReplyText: America's favorite underdog just stole the room! Fire up the six-column gauntlet!

scenes.title: Passport Stamped: London Next
scenes.locationSubhead: Starlight VIP Departure Lounge - Act II Victory

beats.speaker: priya_nair
beats.text: You out-calmed an ER surgeon in front of fourteen million people! Take that transatlantic boarding pass, go give Lord Alistair Finch a proper headache in London, and keep my phone number handy for Cairo!

beats.speaker: max_sterling
beats.text: Forty-two folding chairs in the rain... to National Prime-Time Champion! Pack your Tour Trunk and your sharpest Lucky Charms - Act III opens inside London's marble Grand Rotunda, with thirty-four million global viewers waiting!

scenes.title: Standby Boarding for Heathrow
scenes.locationSubhead: JFK Departure Gate -> London Redemption Circuit

beats.speaker: priya_nair
beats.text: What a war! You forced my pulse above ninety for the first time in three years. Don't unpack that Tour Trunk - I have a feeling London hasn't seen the last of you.

beats.speaker: producer_sam
beats.text: Not even close to over! Fourteen million viewers flooded the global poll demanding you on the plane - grab this crimson boarding pass for London's International Redemption Wildcard and crash Act III from the undercard!
